sentences.en: Hello and welcome to this podcast telling you about our annual business exhibition. This year, as always, it will be full of the very best speakers, features and innovations.
sentences.zh: 你好，欢迎收听本期播客，为您介绍我们的年度商业展览。今年，一如往常，展会将汇聚最优秀的演讲嘉宾、精彩特色活动及前沿创新成果。

sentences.en: Let me start by reading some feedback from James Craig, who's exhibited with us for the past two years. James says, 'I'm director of a company called TalkCon, which is an office phone system. The first year we exhibited, we had a stand in the Business Village, where we made a lot of useful contacts. We also used the Breakout area where people could sit down and relax. and try out our products. and due to popular request we used that again last year. Last year we also sponsored the innovative Business Connections Zone where people could leave their contact details on a board to contact other companies, and that also effectively raised our corporate profile. We"re hoping that in the coming exhibition we'll also have a presence in the Digital Marketing centre, which is clearly a key area for our company. And also maybe have our own Talkcon Zone, at some stage.' The exhibition's open from 8am to 11 pm and there's a range of special events for you to enjoy in the evening.
sentences.zh: 让我先朗读一下詹姆斯·克雷格（James Craig）的反馈意见，他已连续两年参加我们的展会。詹姆斯表示：'我是名为TalkCon公司的总监，我们主营办公电话系统。第一年参展时，我们在商务村设有展位，借此结识了许多有价值的合作伙伴。我们还利用了“ breakout”休息区——人们可以在此坐下放松并试用我们的产品；由于反响热烈，去年我们再次使用了该区域。去年，我们还赞助了富有创意的“商务联络区”，参会者可将联系方式留在展板上，以便与其他公司取得联系，此举也有效提升了我们公司的企业形象。我们希望在即将举办的展会中，也能入驻数字营销中心——这显然是我们公司的一个关键领域；此外，或许还能在某个阶段设立专属的TalkCon专区。' 展会开放时间为上午8点至晚上11点，晚间还将为您呈现一系列精彩特别活动。

sentences.en: As well as a unique chance to publicise your company, businesses who exhibit with us can claim discounts on a number of popular brands, including major high street fashion and jewellery outlets. as well as grocery chains. Discounts available range from 3.5% up to an amazing 15%, so you can save a lot of money. In fact, the average saving made by each exhibitor came to over £400! The scheme is available to every member of your organisation so this is a benefit that really does have something for you all.
sentences.zh: 除提供独一无二的企业宣传机会外，参展企业还可享受多个热门品牌的折扣优惠，涵盖主流街头时尚与珠宝门店，以及大型连锁超市。折扣幅度从3.5%至高达15%不等，助您节省大量开支。事实上，每位参展商平均节省金额超过400英镑！该优惠计划面向贵组织全体成员开放，因此这是一项真正惠及全员的福利。

sentences.en: Now let me tell you about some of our keynote speakers for this year's exhibition.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我为您介绍本届展会的部分主旨演讲嘉宾。

sentences.en: Jim Clowrie started off selling vegetables from a small plot, then opened a small café.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·克洛里（Jim Clowrie）最初在一小块土地上销售蔬菜，随后开设了一家小型咖啡馆。

sentences.en: Rather to his surprise this became a bit of a sensation, and in a remarkably short time he had opened an amazing 76 restaurants worldwide. He'll be telling you how it all happened, and how it changed his life.
sentences.zh: 令他颇感意外的是，这家咖啡馆竟迅速走红；短短时间内，他便在全球成功开设了76家餐厅。他将向您讲述这一切是如何发生的，以及这一经历如何改变了他的人生。

sentences.en: David France will be giving an inspirational talk about how as a business-minded teenager he managed to set up his own company, and even to be the first person under 18 to get a business bank account. David's company has gone from strength to strength but he isn't just interested in making money - he also makes regular donations to organisations helping those in need both in the UK and elsewhere in the world.
sentences.zh: 大卫·弗朗斯（David France）将带来一场鼓舞人心的演讲，讲述他作为一名具有商业头脑的青少年，如何创办了自己的公司，甚至成为英国首位未满18岁即成功开设企业银行账户的人。大卫的公司持续发展壮大，但他不仅关注盈利——他还定期向援助英国及世界各地弱势群体的各类组织捐款。

sentences.en: 011/12 011/12 013/14 013/14 Oliver Stanton was born and educated in the UK, and then went to Malaysia where he set up a rubber-wood furniture business. He then built log houses in the mountains in Japan before moving to Hong Kong to set up a digital marketing business. After that he moved back to the UK with his wife Saiphin, and together they opened a Thai café. He'll be telling you about what he discovered during his travels around the world about business practices in different cultures.
sentences.zh: 奥利弗·斯坦顿（Oliver Stanton）出生于英国并在英国接受教育，之后前往马来西亚创办了一家橡胶木家具企业；随后又在日本山区建造原木房屋；继而移居香港创立一家数字营销公司；此后携妻子赛芬（Saiphin）返回英国，共同开设了一家泰国风味咖啡馆。他将在演讲中分享自己环游世界期间，在不同文化背景下所观察到的商业实践及其启示。

sentences.en: Francesca Heptonstall is a broadcaster and businesswoman who's known for her down­ to-earth attitude. After winning a top job in a TV contest, she launched a number of online deal sites. Her main business interest is in technology, but she's also passionate about helping people gain employment and organises an annual jobs fair, so she'll be concentrating on this in her talk.
sentences.zh: 弗朗西斯卡·赫普顿斯塔尔（Francesca Heptonstall）是一位广播主持人兼企业家，以务实亲和的风格著称。她在一场电视竞赛中赢得重要职位后，创办了多家线上优惠信息网站。她主要专注于科技领域，同时也热衷于帮助人们实现就业，并每年组织一场就业博览会；因此，她的演讲将聚焦于这一主题。

sentences.en: Salman Khan is the Chief Executive of OBF Enterprises, and has turned around this business from a major publishing business to one of the UK's largest digital marketing service providers. He'll be talking about the need for flexibility to cope with new directions in 9 today's business world.
sentences.zh: 萨尔曼·汗（Salman Khan）是OBF企业集团首席执行官，成功将该公司由一家大型出版企业转型为英国最大的数字营销服务提供商之一。他将围绕当今商业世界中应对新发展方向所需的灵活性展开演讲。

sentences.en: Finally, Annie Craven is a consultant and coach who works with people to create lasting changes in their business and life. Her session will offer an interactive look at different obstacles in people's own lives, not just in business. She also looks at how you can overcome them, whether you're starting out in business or at the top of your game.
sentences.zh: 最后，安妮·克雷文（Annie Craven）是一位顾问兼教练，致力于协助人们在其事业与生活中实现持久改变。她的工作坊将以互动方式探讨人们生活中（不仅限于商业领域）所面临的各类障碍，并指导您如何克服这些挑战——无论您是创业新手，还是行业翘楚。
